description: This file defines the 'Group' entity class for managing user groups in the system, including properties like group name, type, permissions, and audit details. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping and implements an auditable interface.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Entity class representing a user group with permissions and audit information in the system.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the set of permissions associated with the group.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets the permissions for the group.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit information for the group.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for the group.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of the group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the group.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the group.

methods.name: setGroupName
methods.description: Sets the name for the group.
